name: graph-first-navigation
body:
The ordering discipline that ALREADY governs the codebase-navigator (installed by the prior graph-first-prompt change-set, not by 0.17.0): for any fact about code or structure — declarations, dependencies, containment, enumeration, discovery — the program graph is consulted first, and file tools are confirmatory (open the graph's `path` at its `start_line`/`end_line`) or cover artifacts the graph does not model in symbols (the not-in-graph class means NO SYMBOLS, not NO NODE: Ruby sources pending `apg-ruby` and binaries have no frontend, so they appear only as residual `misc` `File` nodes with no Module/Struct/Function facts; only paths the config scope and the standard exclusions remove have no node at all).

Both the ordering and the in-graph / not-in-graph artifact-class boundary are baseline: the installed `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` rule 1 states the ordering for ANY code/structure question, discovery and enumeration included, and names both classes; the coherence test `rust.apg.tests.e2e.graph_first_rule_stated_in_navigator_prompt_and_guide` already asserts it. 0.17.0 installs no new rule.

0.17.0's delta is ONLY to SHRINK the not-in-graph class: because the bundled structural scanner graphs every tracked text/config/packaging file, tracked `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock` (toml), `install.sh` (sh), `.github/workflows/release.yml` (yaml), `apg/config.json` and `opencode-suite/package.json` (json), and `LICENSE` (misc) move from "not in the graph" to "in the graph"; the not-in-graph class is left meaning no symbols, not no node — Ruby sources (`Formula/*.rb`, pending `apg-ruby`) and binaries remain residual `misc` `File` nodes with no Module/Struct/Function facts, and only paths the config scope (`apg/config.json`) and the standard exclusions (`.git`, `target`, `node_modules`, `.gitignore`, `--exclude-path`) remove have no node at all. The earlier framing of this entity — that the observed failure persisted "because the prompt scoped graph-first to relationships and left discovery unstated" — was stale and self-contradictory with the installed prompt and the sibling note `requirements.note.graph-first-artifact-class-shrink`.
